exposure: placental thickness in the lower uterine segment
Placental thickness in the lower uterine segment
cohort: 131 women with ultrasound evidence of major placenta previa or a low-lying anterior placenta
finding: Lower uterine segment placental thickness is increased in women with AIP compared to those with noninvasive placentation, and this association may be clinically valuable in improving prenatal detection of AIP in women with placental implantation in the lower uterine segment.
